theme_strategy: Apple iOS ad-style structure fused with liquid glassmorphism, rounded edges. Premium, high-end, authoritative. One bold cohesive art direction.
bilingual_support: Albanian (SQ) and English (EN) with seamless language toggle state. All text elements should be wrapped in translation logic or conditional rendering.

typography.headings: Clash Display (Fontshare) - Sharp, authoritative, distinctive. NEVER use Inter/Roboto.
typography.body: Manrope (Google Fonts) - Clean, geometric, perfect legibility at small sizes.
typography.brand_mark: Create a typographic logo using Clash Display (Bold/Semibold) with tight tracking ('tracking-tighter'). No generic icons.
typography.import_instructions: Import Clash Display from Fontshare CDN and Manrope from Google Fonts in index.css.

visual_enhancers.liquid_glass: bg-white/5 backdrop-blur-[24px] backdrop-saturate-150 border border-white/10 shadow-[0_8px_32px_rgba(0,0,0,0.4)]
visual_enhancers.rounded_edges: Use 'rounded-3xl' or 'rounded-[2rem]' for main structural cards and 'rounded-full' for buttons.
visual_enhancers.noise_texture: Apply a very subtle 2-3% opacity grain/noise SVG pattern over the matte black background to make it feel tactile, not flat digital.
visual_enhancers.no_transparency_trap: NEVER use complete transparent backgrounds in header/overlays where content sits underneath. Always use the liquid_glass token.

component_rules.hero_kinetic: Signature on-load moment. Use Framer Motion. Large headings wrapped in 'overflow-hidden'. Text elements start at 'y: 100%' and stagger reveal to 'y: 0' with ease: [0.76, 0, 0.24, 1].
component_rules.quiz_experience: Full-screen fixed modal ('z-50', 'inset-0') when 'Choose Your Vanguard' is clicked. Deep black background with blurred liquid glass active card. Use Framer Motion 'AnimatePresence' for sliding between the 10 questions. Include a faux loading spinner step before revealing the recommended service.
component_rules.editorial_marquee: One slow, smooth marquee using 'react-fast-marquee'. Low contrast text (e.g., text-muted) with wide tracking. Words like: 'PHYSICAL SECURITY • CLOSE PROTECTION • SURVEILLANCE • TACTICAL RESPONSE'.
component_rules.buttons: Pill-shaped ('rounded-full'). Primary CTA: Matte Gold background with black text, subtle scale on hover. Secondary: Glassmorphic with gold border and white text.

grids_and_layouts.spacing: Generous spacing. Use 'py-24' or 'py-32' for sections. Container padding 'px-6 md:px-12'.
grids_and_layouts.services_bento: Mode A (Tetris Grid). 'grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-12 gap-6'. Massive featured service spanning 8 columns, smaller services spanning 4. Never fill 100% symmetrically; leave intentional negative space.
grids_and_layouts.header: Sticky top, 'z-40', liquid glass background. Minimalist layout: Typographic logo left, Nav center, Language Toggle (SQ/EN) right.
grids_and_layouts.contact_section: Half text/manifesto, half sleek minimalist form. Use standard Shadcn/UI inputs but heavily customized: transparent background, gold focus rings, bottom border only (Apple style) or sleek fully rounded inputs.

motion.scrolling: MANDATORY: Use 'lenis' library for smooth momentum scrolling. It gives the 'Apple-ad' weighty feel.
motion.transitions: Use Framer Motion. Spring animations for micro-interactions (stiffness 400, damping 30). Parallax effect on the main hero background image (scroll mapped to Y translation).
motion.stagger: Stagger children appearances in bento grids using 'delayChildren' and 'staggerChildren'.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure text over glass meets APCA/WCAG ratios. Use text-shadow ('drop-shadow-md') on text placed directly over images.
accessibility.testing_tags: All interactive elements, quiz options, buttons, and form inputs MUST include 'data-testid' attributes (e.g., 'data-testid="choose-vanguard-btn"').

media_and_images.strategy: Spotlight imagery, dark tones, clipped frames (rounded-3xl). Never use placeholders.

universal_guidelines_for_main_agent: NO AI SLOP: Do not use generic centered layouts, simple linear gradients, or predictable Tailwind structures.
Bilingual content is mandatory. Structure your components to easily switch between 'SQ' and 'EN' strings.
Include 'data-testid' on ALL buttons, links, and quiz selections.
Do NOT use 'transition: all'. Explicitly animate transform, opacity, and background-color.
For the brand mark, just use styled text. Do not add generic shield or lock icons.
Implement 'Choose Your Vanguard' as a robust full-screen interactive component, tracking answers in state to show a final recommendation card.
